featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently visited 51 Rambo Ice Cream Shop in Jogeshwari, opposite Farooq’s school, with our friends and families. We ordered a family pack, which is usually served in a tray, but instead it was given to us in a parcel container.

We Ordered for -
• Ice cream cones of different flavours namely
Blueberry, Roasted almond ,American dryfruit, Rajbhog and Chocolate marble.
• 3 idiots sundae worth 300 which serves 2 to 3 people. It's super delicious and yumm.
• Cold coco which is beautifully curated and tastes heavenly.
• Double chocolate waffle - Super crispy and chocolaty.
• Fresh strawberry roll- live prepared icecream pan rolls topped with fresh Strawberries. It's worth trying.
Their desserts are prepared hygienically following all the safety protocols and are fresh.They have a seating for 3 4 people indoors and few tables for outdoor seating.
Its definitely a hidden gem serving delectable desserts at such low cost 😍
Definitely visiting here again and would recommend everyone to visit here too.

featured_reviews.name: Fizza Ratlamwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are a big ice-cream lover than this is a perfect place for you to visit as they have huge variety of ice-creams, ice-cream sodas, shakes, sundaes etc. They serve waffles as well but when i had visited it was not available.

I ordered had 'Hot Chocolate Fudge Sundae' it was vanilla ice-cream covered fully with dark hot chocolate fudge and cashew nut. A must try it is. Then i had ordered 'Blueberry Cheesecake in Waffle Cup' it was very minimally sweet and was very delicious.

In beverages i had ordered 'Golden Glow Ice-cream Soda' this is something which i had for the first time. It was a vanilla ice-cream based soda with a touch of orange sauce. They have various flavours as well. Secondly I ordered, 'Dutch Brownie Premium Thick Shake' this is a must try. This was really chocolaty & thick & also tasted super delicious.

featured_reviews.review_text:

This time i visited the versova outlet managed by Kamlesh Kumar Yadav.

One can also binge on some sundaes which can be customised as per your liking. The icecream cakes are also getting popular and also my personal fav the gulkand kulfis.

The prices are pocket friendly and there are some or another offers going on.

At Giani's belgian icecream will surely ring your bells

featured_reviews.name: Allan Banis
featured_reviews.review_text:
Idk how this place has so many good reviews. May be friends and family or may be im the outlier.  The ice cream flavours aren't anything special. I didn't like it one bit. The cone flavour also felt like the cone was partly burnt . It's near havmour and apsara and I don't think it gives any serious competition to them positives is the staff is really nice and accommodating the interior is also good enough for an iceream parlour. Downside is the ice cream kinda really s**ks. They put actual bubble gum in the icecream in one of the flavours. It's innovative I give you that but it messes the taste of the icecream it's not like the bubblegum is at the end like in that lollipop that comes there are pieces of bubblegum so as you eating the icecream you have to juggle the ever growing bubble gum. The flavours try to be as genuine as possible but I feel apsara provides a better taste. The cone is the actual nail in the coffin if they change the cone they could really turn things quiet around they do have some genuine flavours which taste like you having the real thing like guava or gulkhand but the cone ruins those few good flavours they have.
P.S. idk if it'll still be there but there is a Post-It review that has a drawing of an icecream that looks like a pe*is you should check that out

Summer calls for popsicles!
We tried these colourful popsicles from the newly launched Little Loco Pops. The carton was well packed and it contained dry ice inside the box to prevent the popsicles from melting. This really goes a long way!
All the popsicles are made with fresh fruits and contain no artificial flavouring or preservatives.

We tried the mix box containing 6 flavours :

1. Mojito : This is honestly a refrigerator staple to beat the heat. It contains real mint leaves mixed with the sweet lemonade, the prominent flavour of the popsicle. A classic!

2. Citrus Plum : This is a duo of Egyptian oranges and plum. The mix of the two flavours, will be a favourite for those who have a liking towards sour flavours.

3. Watermelon Kiwi : Indeed a unique combination, this contains fresh watermelon and kiwi juices turned into a popsicle.

4. Triple Berry : Our personal favourite, this cooler contains strawberries, blueberries and blackberries. You actually have the berries in the cooler and we love the combination of all the flavours!

5. Hazelnut : We can't think of a better way to beat the summer than to relish this yummy Hazelnut pop. If you guys like the subtle taste of hazelnut, this one is for you!

6. Strawberry and Cream : We personally liked this flavour! The strawberries used were fresh from Mahabaleshwar and the popsicle is super creamy♥️

PS: These popsicles melt very quickly so don't waste time clicking photos like we did

The Death by Chocolate Sundae is a dream for chocolate lovers, packed with layers of rich chocolate ice cream, sauce, brownie chunks, and crunchy chocolate bits. The Tutti Frutti Sundae is a refreshing burst of fruity goodness, while the Royal Falooda Sundae delivers classic falooda flavours in a rich and nostalgic dessert experience.

What makes Apsara stand out is its commitment to crafting ice creams using real fruits and premium ingredients, with a wide range of unique flavours that keep customers coming back for more.

Whether you’re craving chocolate, fruity delights, or traditional Indian dessert flavours, these new sundaes are worth every spoonful.
